purpose: State and territory source inventory for GWT-relevant procurement, contract lifecycle, Medicaid/CMS/RHT updates, and future adapter deployment.

tag_definitions.opportunities: Open solicitations, RFPs, RFIs, bids, sources sought, funding opportunities.
tag_definitions.contracts: Awarded/current statewide contracts or contract records.
tag_definitions.awards: Award notices, apparent awards, award history, bid tabulations.
tag_definitions.incumbents: Vendor/party searchable contract history useful for incumbent tracking.
tag_definitions.expiring_contracts: Records with end dates, renewals, or term metadata useful for recompete windows.
tag_definitions.procurement_updates: Addenda, amendments, cancellation notices, award updates, portal change notices.
tag_definitions.grants: State grant/funding postings where present in the procurement source.
tag_definitions.medicaid_updates: State Medicaid/health program notices or procurement updates relevant to Medicaid/CMS work.
tag_definitions.rht_updates: Rural health transformation, rural hospital, CAH, workforce, telehealth, or rural funding signals.
tag_definitions.open_data: Socrata/open-data/catalog API or machine-readable public data endpoint.

access_method_definitions.official_portal_json: Known public JSON endpoint used by an official portal.
access_method_definitions.public_portal_adapter: Official public portal; probe browser traffic for JSON/XHR or stable query endpoints.
access_method_definitions.vendor_platform_adapter: Reusable vendor platform adapter likely needed, e.g. BSO, VSS, PeopleSoft, Jaggaer/SciQuest.
access_method_definitions.html_form_adapter: HTML form/search with server-side state or query params.
access_method_definitions.html_search_adapter: Search/listing pages without known API; scrape conservatively.
access_method_definitions.html_page_adapter: Single page or small page set with dated notices/funding windows.
access_method_definitions.manual_probe_required: Source needs manual discovery before implementation.

implementation_notes: Do not assume all target portals expose official APIs. Treat target_api as the first adapter target, not a verified endpoint unless access_method is official_portal_json.
Cap MVP at two portal families per jurisdiction: one opportunities source and one contracts/incumbents source.
Prefer sources with vendor search, end dates, award dates, solicitation numbers, and downloadable/exportable rows.
Normalize rows into data/state_opportunities.csv and data/state_contracts.csv until a dedicated state lifecycle catalog is introduced.
Keep state work separate from federal catalogs unless a later builder joins them.
